verdict.rationale: Semgrep has a public GitHub repository (semgrep/semgrep) whose README describes the engine and local analysis, which shows its source is readable. No item in the pack names the license, and a community comment notes that Supply Chain is not open source, so only part of the product appears open. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an open-source license (e.g. LGPL/MIT text or a docs statement), clarity on which components are open versus proprietary, and independent corroboration of license terms.
